en: Black-and-white postcard showing a large modernist railway station building with cubic volumes and grid-like window façades. A clock is visible above the main entrance. In front of the station is a busy square with people walking, cyclists, a tram or bus, cars, and lampposts. Low vegetation occupies the foreground. Printed text at the bottom left reads "Meißen a.d. Elbe - Bahnhof".
